review_evidence: README identifies the repository as the Heidelberg 2024 computer-assisted mathematics seminar.
Lean/07_intro_to_Lean.lean through 09_advanced_tactics.lean contain executable definitions and proved propositions, while Assignment and Projects contain theorem developments.
Project paths include substantive formalizations such as continuity and Euclidean-domain/PID structures, so tutorial/assignment path names are not a lossless exclusion criterion.
summary: Retain CompAssistedMath2024: seminar/tutorial files and student projects contain explicit Lean definitions, theorem statements, and proofs across logic, algebra, and analysis.
